## Summary

Pratham Ranka is a software engineer focused on backend engineering, distributed systems,
production infrastructure, open-source software, and product development. His work includes
backend APIs, distributed workflows, fintech infrastructure, cloud-native systems,
privacy-preserving payments, developer tools, testing infrastructure, and full-stack products.

## Work Experience

### Software Engineer — S45
July 2026 – August 2026

Contributed to production backend systems by implementing features from HLD and LLD
specifications, building a standardized multi-layer testing framework, developing shared testing
infrastructure, writing unit and integration tests, strengthening repository contract tests,
validating database migrations, and improving CI quality gates. Also contributed to code reviews,
bug fixes, and production engineering practices focused on maintainability, reliability, and
long-term scalability.

### Software Engineer Intern — Paasa
March 2026 – May 2026

Engineered fintech infrastructure for KYC, payouts, collections, and financial reconciliation.
Built and optimized backend APIs, integrated banking partners, improved transaction reliability,
automated internal operations, and contributed to production systems handling more than $19M in
assets. Paasa is a YC S24 company.

### Full-Stack Engineering Intern — TalKeys
June 2025 – August 2025

Developed production-ready features across the React and Node.js stack, implemented REST APIs,
integrated third-party services, improved application performance, resolved production issues,
and collaborated in an agile environment to ship reliable customer-facing functionality.

## Projects

### AgentPay
Go 1.22+, AWS Lambda ARM64, API Gateway HTTP API v2, DynamoDB, Terraform, Next.js 14,
TypeScript, x402 Protocol

Modular monolith with 17 isolated domain packages across catalog, intents, payments, proxy,
evidence, disputes, and settlement. It enables non-custodial x402 USDC micro-transactions on
Base Sepolia so AI agents and browser buyers can purchase APIs with exact-price on-chain
settlement. The system achieved less than 42ms P95 API latency, less than 8ms P99 DynamoDB query
latency, and operational costs under $10/month.

The backend uses a DynamoDB single-table architecture with four GSIs, more than 188 entity access
patterns, and conditional-write idempotency without distributed locking. An append-only audit
ledger uses S3 Object Lock, AWS KMS P-256 ECDSA signatures, and chained transaction hashes for
deterministic dispute resolution. The upstream proxy is SSRF-hardened with URL sanitization,
private IP and AWS metadata endpoint blocking, replay protection, and short-lived ES256 execution
capabilities.

Terraform provisions 67 AWS resources across foundation, identity, and application modules using
S3 remote state, DynamoDB locking, IAM least privilege, and AWS Budgets. A TypeScript MCP
connector uses stdio JSON-RPC, five-minute ES256 capabilities, and seller confirmation grants for
secure IDE agent interactions. The Next.js 14 frontend uses the App Router, React Server
Components, and Tailwind CSS, with 100/100 Lighthouse Accessibility and SEO scores and less than
80ms FCP. SDKs and cryptographic verification cover Go, TypeScript, Python, Java, .NET, PHP, and
Ruby, with GitHub Actions CI, OpenAPI and AsyncAPI validation, and automated security regression
testing.

GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/AgentPay

### SendAI Fun
TypeScript, Next.js, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Redis

Cloud-native runtime for AI agents that securely executes tool calls inside Kubernetes sandboxes
using distributed lease management, optimistic concurrency control, FIFO scheduling, automatic
recovery, and production-grade container orchestration.

GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/sendaifun

### StarSwap
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Redis, PostgreSQL

Developer platform for discovering GitHub repositories with intelligent recommendations, GitHub
OAuth, Redis-powered caching and rate limiting, PostgreSQL, real-time leaderboards, and a scalable
full-stack architecture.

GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/starswap

### ZKavach
Next.js, TypeScript, Solidity, snarkjs, ethers, Base

Privacy-preserving payment infrastructure implementing Coinbase x402 with Groth16 zk-SNARKs,
Poseidon hashing, Solidity smart contracts, and programmable USDC payments for autonomous AI
agents.

GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/ZKavach

### SpotifyDownloader
TypeScript, Node.js, FFmpeg, Jest, GitHub Actions

Production-ready TypeScript CLI featuring concurrent download workers, resumable pipelines,
intelligent source matching, FFmpeg processing, ID3 metadata embedding, automated testing,
CI/CD, and cross-platform support.

GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/SpotifyDownloader

## About This Website

This portfolio is built with Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Motion for React, and a
locally hosted Hanken Grotesk font. It presents Pratham's experience, selected projects,
capabilities, open-source work, and public contact details. The site exposes this file as a
plain-text, machine-readable profile at `/llms.txt` and includes structured metadata for the
profile, projects, and experience.

Q: What is AgentPay?
A: AgentPay is a Go modular monolith for non-custodial x402 USDC payments on Base Sepolia. It
uses AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3 Object Lock, KMS signatures, Terraform, and a
Next.js frontend to support secure API purchases, cryptographic evidence, dispute resolution,
and AI-agent tooling.
